customer_profiles_birthday_valid.name: customer_profiles_birthday_valid
customer_profiles_birthday_valid.value: ("customer_profiles"."birthday_day" IS NULL AND "customer_profiles"."birthday_month" IS NULL) OR ("customer_profiles"."birthday_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "customer_profiles"."birthday_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12)

outbox_replay_idx.name: outbox_replay_idx
outbox_replay_idx.where: "outbox"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "outbox"."failed_at" IS NULL

outbox_finished_idx.name: outbox_finished_idx
outbox_finished_idx.where: "outbox"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL OR "outbox"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL

outbox_completed_after_dispatch.name: outbox_completed_after_dispatch
outbox_completed_after_dispatch.value: "outbox"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL
